title: Free tutorial: The same hunt in KQL
summary: Ask the same question in KQL, the other big SIEM search language.

next.title: Seminar 2: Log search and detection as code

script.intro: Welcome. SPL and KQL are the two big SIEM search languages. Here you ask the same question in KQL and check you get the same answer.
script.outro: Once you can think in the question and not the syntax, switching SIEMs is easy. Seminar 2 builds that skill.
steps: Read the setting so you know the company, the date and the time zone. Then open the evidence in the case folder.

KQL starts with a table, then pipes into operators. Where filters. Summarize count by groups. Project picks columns. Sort by orders. Remember the count column is called count underscore, strings use double equals and double quotes. Run the hunt you ran in SPL. The answer must be identical. If it is not, one of the two searches is wrong, and finding which is the skill.
Once you can think in the question and not the syntax, switching SIEMs is easy. Seminar 2 builds that skill.
